name: Edge Spectrum: Market Close Capture
description: Fetches the last ten days of end-of-day prices for named tickers (SPY, QQQ, GLD and HYG by default) from Tiingo and appends each trading day not yet recorded to <output>/<TICKER>.jsonl: close, adjusted close, dividend and split factor, with the capture time. Append-only, one request per ticker. Needs your own free Tiingo key as TIINGO_API_KEY in site/.env, Node 22 or 24 and a clone of edge-spectrum with `npm ci` run in site/. Tiingo's free plan is for personal use only: keep the archive to yourself.

parameters.label: edge-spectrum clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-spectrum, with `npm ci` run in its site/ folder.

parameters.label: Close archive folder
parameters.help: Where the per-ticker JSONL files go. Files are only ever appended to.

parameters.label: Tickers
parameters.help: Comma-separated symbols, no spaces. Each is one request a run; the free plan allows 50 an hour.

author: ai-automation-tools
